kind: a coastal fishery with named sites and a yearly lottery
one_line: A hundred boats, a written list of named fishing spots, and a draw each September that assigns them.
insider_rationale: keep the list of named sites
monitor_rationale: reads the landing logs against the site list; four months, then we look again

ladder.label: one-site-one-day
ladder.text: A boat fishes the site it drew that day, and no other.

shared.label: cooperative-buys
shared.text: Anything bought out of the cooperative's fund is agreed before it is bought.

access.label: licensed-locals
access.text: A licensed local boat may enter the draw; nobody else may.

inner_a.label: sites-named
inner_a.text: The sites are a written list, spaced so that no boat's net reaches the next.

inner_b.label: sites-rotate
inner_b.text: Assignments move east one site a day through the season, then west.

clash_a.label: no-swapping
clash_a.text: A drawn site is not traded, because a traded site is a bought site.

clash_b.label: engine-trouble
clash_b.text: A boat that cannot reach its site does not lose the day.

extra.label: list-posted
extra.text: The day's assignments are posted in the coffeehouse by dark.

policy.root: We decide by consent: one reasoned objection stops a thing, and saying nothing is not an objection. Changing something we have called a principle takes the cooperative, and anything we cannot undo is not decided by silence.
policy.inner: Whoever keeps the list of sites decides the sites.
policy.unheld: The harbour itself is decided by whoever holds it.
policy.ladder: The first time we ask. The second time the cooperative asks together. The third time the answer is no.
policy.inner_amended: Two of us have to object before a change to the sites stops.

inner_proposal.text: add four sites between the existing ones for the short-net boats
inner_proposal.because: a short net does not reach the next site, so the spacing that protects the long nets is spare capacity

inner_objection: the spacing is measured off the longest net in the fleet, and the fleet's nets change faster than the list does

unheld_proposal.text: dredge the harbour mouth and lengthen the eastern mole

monitor_watch.about: a landing logged from a site that was not drawn
monitor_watch.because: the boat's log names a site assigned to another boat that day
monitor_watch.dismissal: these two do not really conflict

ladder_subject.about: fishing a site you did not draw
ladder_subject.first: work the neighbouring site because the drawn one was fouled
ladder_subject.second: work the neighbouring site again on the following day
ladder_subject.third: work the good eastern sites for the rest of the week
ladder_subject.because: a site fished by two boats is a site that produces for neither, which is what the list exists to prevent
ladder_subject.ruling_1: the drawn site had a net down in it and we let it stand
ladder_subject.ruling_2: the cooperative agreed one more, then no more

other_subject.text: land the catch at the next harbour when the price is better there

clash.about: a boat that cannot reach its site
clash.text: let a boat with a failed engine take the nearest free site for the day
clash.because_a: a site taken outside the draw is a site somebody chose, and choosing is what the draw removes
clash.because_b: a boat that loses the day for a failed engine loses the week, and the fleet is small enough to feel it
clash.carried: the free site is only ever the one nobody drew, and the engine is checked by two others before the day is given; revisit at the next September draw

amend_convention.text: post the day's assignments to the cooperative's phone group instead of the coffeehouse
amend_convention.because: half the fleet is at sea when the list goes up on the wall

amend_principle.text: allow two boats to swap sites if both tell the keeper first
amend_principle.because: a declared swap is visible, and the thing the rule fears is the undeclared one

irreversible.text: strike the four western sites off the list for good and let the ground rest

silence.about: who tows a boat in when one goes down
silence.rationale: the nearest boat has always gone and always will, and a rota would put a name on something that has never once needed one
silence.proposal: set a towing rota for the season

panel.rationale: three of us to look at the swapping rule for a month
